messages.text: I released Clipbook last month. It saves copied links.
The new Gemini announcement looks impressive!
I built Noted: voice notes transcribed locally on a Mac. https://noted.example
Tab tidy update: it now groups tabs by project, not just domain. GitHub, docs and issues can stay together.
It uses Whisper on the device. It is free and works offline.

posts.title: Noted: Local Voice Note Transcription for Mac
posts.summary: A free Mac app for transcribing voice notes locally and offline using on-device Whisper.
posts.detail: Noted transcribes voice notes locally on a Mac using on-device Whisper. It runs completely offline, is free to use, and is available at https://noted.example.

posts.title: Tab tidy
posts.summary: A Chrome extension that groups browser tabs by project rather than just by domain.
posts.detail: Tab tidy organizes browser tabs into project-based groups instead of grouping solely by domain. This allows related tabs across multiple sites—such as GitHub repositories, documentation, and issue trackers—to stay together in the same group.
